tools.name: post_campaign_stats_to_slack
tools.description: Looks up delivery and engagement metrics for a campaign from the marketing database and posts a summary message to the team's Slack channel via webhook.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to summarize.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Slack incoming webhook URL to post the summary to.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "marketing.db"


@tool
def post_campaign_stats_to_slack(campaign_id: str, webhook_url: str) -> dict:
    """Post campaign stats to Slack."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    campaign = conn.execute(
        "SELECT name, subject, sent_at FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?",
        (campaign_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    stats = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS sent, "
        "SUM(CASE WHEN delivered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered, "
        "SUM(CASE WHEN opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opens, "
        "SUM(CASE WHEN clicked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clicks, "
        "SUM(CASE WHEN bounced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounces, "
        "SUM(CASE WHEN unsubscribed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsubs "
        "FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = ?",
        (campaign_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    conn.close()

    name = campaign["name"] if campaign else campaign_id
    sent = stats["sent"] or 0
    delivered = stats["delivered"] or 0
    opens = stats["opens"] or 0
    clicks = stats["clicks"] or 0
    bounces = stats["bounces"] or 0
    unsubs = stats["unsubs"] or 0
    denom = max(delivered, 1)
    open_rate = round(100 * opens / denom, 2)
    click_rate = round(100 * clicks / denom, 2)

    text = (
        f"*Campaign report: {name}*\n"
        f"Sent: {sent} | Delivered: {delivered} | Bounces: {bounces}\n"
        f"Opens: {opens} ({open_rate}%) | Clicks: {clicks} ({click_rate}%)\n"
        f"Unsubscribes: {unsubs}"
    )
    resp = requests.post(webhook_url, json={"text": text}, timeout=10)
    return {
        "campaign_id": campaign_id,
        "posted": resp.ok,
        "status_code": resp.status_code,
        "summary": text,
    }

tools.name: check_campaign_spam_score
tools.description: Loads a campaign's subject, sender, and HTML body from the marketing database and runs it through SpamAssassin to get a spam score and the rules that were triggered.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign whose content should be scored.

params.name: threshold
params.description: Score at or above which the campaign is flagged as likely spam (default 5.0).
